title: REST deprecation work item 2: deployments, observations, artifacts
intent: Remove REST mutation endpoints for deployment intent creation, deployment approval/rejection, rollback, runtime observation submission, and artifact registration because these mutations are handled by signed Nostr control-plane events.
observed_behavior_before: router.go registered POST /deployments/intents, POST /deployments/intents/{id}/approve, POST /deployments/intents/{id}/reject, POST /rollback, POST /observations, and POST /artifacts.
HTTP handlers accepted direct JSON mutations for those operations.
Router tests used removed REST mutations as setup paths.
intended_behavior: The six REST mutation routes are unavailable.
Read endpoints and deployment run endpoints that remain in scope continue to work.
Public client helpers do not attempt removed REST writes and instead fail with signer-first Nostr guidance.
Nostr reactor handling for these operations remains unchanged.
out_of_scope: Deleting domain types or repository/service methods used by the Nostr reactor.
Rewriting CLI or MCP mutation surfaces to publish signed Nostr events; tracked by bahia-hygp.
